critical_code_review_comments: Consider using explicit response_model=TeacherOut on POST /api/admin/teachers instead of manual dict stripping — safer long-term (prevents future field leaks like password_hash if someone forgets to strip).
Same _id/serialization pattern is used in add_aluno and add_instrumento (pop _id manually). Works but a Pydantic response_model on each POST is more robust.

CORS allows origins '*' with allow_credentials=True — invalid combination per spec (browsers reject). Not currently causing issues because frontend uses Bearer tokens in Authorization header (not cookies), but should be tightened.
TeacherOut model is defined but not used as response_model anywhere.
Instrumento question field is 'dom' (not 'dominio' as review spec text sometimes suggests) — confirmed matches frontend.
